activities.title: Belgian Brews at Sugar Creek
activities.description: Explore Belgian-inspired ales in a massive, nautical-themed brewery within the LoSo district. Its social energy and adventurous beer styles make it an essential staple of the local craft scene.

activities.title: Kombucha & Pints at Lenny Boy
activities.description: Visit this diverse taproom known for its organic kombucha, traditional beers, and high-energy social events. It’s an inclusive, wellness-adjacent social baseline for the South End community.
activities.location: Lenny Boy Brewing Co, South End

activities.title: Nature Escape at USNWC
activities.description: Hike the extensive trail system along the river to reset your mental state away from the urban bustle. The natural terrain offers a rugged adventure that showcases the city's access to true wilderness.

activities.title: Market Exploration at Optimist Hall
activities.description: Navigate this massive, transformed textile mill for an early-morning bite from local artisan vendors. It is a sensory-heavy market experience that perfectly showcases the city's culinary and cultural diversity.

activities.title: Morning Run at Freedom Park
activities.description: Jog around the lake at Charlotte's signature urban park before the workday starts. It’s the foundational fitness baseline for the local community, offering scenic views and a highly social atmosphere.

activities.title: Vietnamese Soul at LangVan
activities.description: Experience legendary hospitality at a city staple beloved by the queer community for decades. This essential culinary baseline features a massive menu where the owner treats every regular like family.

activities.title: Art Immersion at Mint Museum Uptown
activities.description: Explore world-class craft, design, and contemporary art in a sleek, architectural gem. It is a sophisticated baseline for an artsy afternoon in the heart of Charlotte's cultural district.

activities.title: Pints at Olde Mecklenburg Brewery
activities.description: Visit the OG Charlotte biergarten for an authentic German-style experience in LoSo. Its massive outdoor space is the city's premier social anchor for weekend brews and bratwurst.

activities.title: Historic Steaks at Beef 'N Bottle
activities.description: Step back in time at this legendary, low-lit steakhouse that has maintained its classic mid-century charm since 1958. It is a foundational, unpretentious piece of Charlotte’s culinary soul.

activities.title: South End Rail Trail Social
activities.description: Walk the three-mile urban vein that defines modern Charlotte social life. It is the city's premier high-visibility corridor for a social stroll, offering endless people-watching and spontaneous entries into local bars.
activities.location: South End Rail Trail, South End

activities.title: Alternative Vibes at Snug Harbor
activities.description: Dive into the heart of Plaza Midwood's underground scene with live music that skews toward the adventurous and authentic. This nautical-themed sanctuary is where the city’s alternative socialites gather for high-energy sets.

activities.title: Cocktail Chemistry at Supperland
activities.description: Visit the speakeasy-style bar hidden within this restored mid-century church for adventurous, alchemical cocktails. The high-design setting and sophisticated crowd make it the peak of Charlotte’s social scene.

activities.title: Treasure Hunting at Sleepy Poet
activities.description: Navigate a sprawling labyrinth of vintage treasures, retro fashion, and oddities that define the city's quirky undercurrent. It is an adventurous morning excursion perfect for finding unique pieces of Charlotte history.
activities.location: Sleepy Poet Antique Mall, South Blvd

activities.title: Custom Spirits at Idlewild
activities.description: Describe your preferences and let expert bartenders build a custom drink just for you in this cozy, menu-less NoDa gem. It is the ultimate destination for adventurous drinkers seeking a personal, high-quality social experience.

activities.title: Refined Southern Dining at Haberdish
activities.description: Feast on elevated Southern staples in an airy, industrial-chic space that captures the refined soul of NoDa. The comforting food and social atmosphere make it a baseline essential for an authentic dinner.

activities.title: Acoustic Open Mic at The Evening Muse
activities.description: Witness raw local talent in NoDa’s premier listening room. The atmosphere is intimate and focused, making it the perfect spot for a midweek cultural deep-dive without the club noise.

activities.title: Retro Gaming at Super Abari
activities.description: Relive the golden age of arcades with rare cabinets and classic pinball in a massive, high-energy warehouse. It is a social playground for competitive spirits who prefer joysticks over dance floors.
activities.location: Super Abari Game Bar, Optimist Park

activities.title: Dinner in the Garden at Goodyear House
activities.description: Dine under the massive holly tree in this converted historic home that blends high-design with approachable Southern comfort. The social energy here is unmatched, representing the peak of NoDa dining.

activities.title: Lakeside Escape to Hello, Sailor
activities.description: Take a short drive North for a mid-century modern dockside experience featuring fish camp vibes and citrusy cocktails. It is a stylish, adventurous getaway that feels worlds away from the city center.

activities.title: Pint & Peanuts at Birdsong Brewing
activities.description: Lean into the unpretentious NoDa baseline at this solar-powered brewery. It’s the ultimate chill social spot where the inclusive vibe is as consistent as the Higher Ground IPA.

activities.title: Lattes & Locals Market
activities.description: Explore a vibrant pop-up market featuring over 100 local vendors, food trucks, and live music. It's a relaxed, walkable experience perfect for discovering unique local goods and enjoying the Sunday atmosphere.
activities.location: Night Swim Roastery and Cafe, South End

activities.title: Rock 'n' Reel Student Album Movie Premiere
activities.description: Catch the premiere of student-produced album movies from We Rock Charlotte, an organization empowering youth through music and film. This 'pay what you want' event supports local talent and offers a unique cultural experience.

activities.title: Sunday Live Music at Triple C Brewing
activities.description: Enjoy an afternoon of free live music at Triple C Brewing's taproom. Grab a craft beer and relax with friends while listening to local artists perform.
activities.location: Triple C Brewing Co. Taproom, South End

activities.title: Something's Brewing: A Fusion Jam Session
activities.description: Immerse yourself in a dynamic fusion jam session at Town Brewing. This free event brings together talented musicians for an afternoon of spontaneous and creative musical exploration.

activities.title: Live Music Sundays at Free Range Brewing
activities.description: Spend your Sunday afternoon enjoying free live music at Free Range Brewing. It's a great spot to unwind, sip on some local brews, and soak in the good vibes.

activities.title: We're Having an Open Mic, Frank!
activities.description: Showcase your talent or enjoy local performers at this free open mic night. Divine Barrel Brewing provides a welcoming atmosphere for comedy, music, and poetry.

activities.title: Music Bingo at Primal Brewery
activities.description: Test your musical knowledge and luck at Music Bingo. It's a fun, free evening activity with a chance to win prizes while enjoying craft beers.

activities.title: Charlotte Blues Society: Sunday Night Blues Jam
activities.description: Join the Charlotte Blues Society for their weekly Sunday Night Blues Jam. Whether you're a musician or a fan, enjoy an evening of soulful blues. Entry is free to $10.

activities.title: Star Wars Day Celebration & Screenings
activities.description: Celebrate Star Wars Day with special screenings, discounts, and a chance to meet Darth Vader. Immerse yourself in the galaxy far, far away at this fan-favorite event.
activities.location: Mac's Heroes & Villains Comics & Collectibles, Plaza Midwood

activities.title: LEGO Star Wars N-1 Starfighter Mini Build
activities.description: Bring out your inner Jedi Master and build a free LEGO Star Wars N-1 Starfighter mini-model. This family-friendly event is perfect for fans of all ages.

activities.title: Queen City Culture & Community Market
activities.description: Discover local artisans, food vendors, and community organizations at this vibrant market. Support small businesses and connect with the diverse culture of Charlotte.

activities.title: BOOM Charlotte Fringe Festival (Outdoor Events)
activities.description: Experience the free outdoor performances and art installations of the BOOM Charlotte Fringe Festival. This multi-day arts festival showcases dance, music, theater, and visual art from regional artists.
activities.location: Shoppes at University Place, University City

activities.title: MOR + Trivia Night
activities.description: Gather your team for a fun night of general knowledge trivia. Enjoy craft beers and friendly competition at one of Charlotte's most popular breweries.

activities.title: Star Wars Trivia Night
activities.description: May the 4th be with you! Test your Star Wars knowledge at this themed trivia night. Prizes for the top teams and a great atmosphere for fans.

activities.title: Mindless Minutia Trivia
activities.description: Challenge your brain with Mindless Minutia Trivia. A popular weekly event offering a wide range of questions and a lively crowd.
activities.location: Monday Night Garden Brewing Co., South End

activities.title: Open Mic Night w/ Tim Hong
activities.description: Discover emerging talent or take the stage yourself at this free open mic night hosted by Tim Hong. A supportive environment for musicians, poets, and comedians.

activities.title: 'SLAY & SASHAY' Drag Brunch
activities.description: Experience Charlotte's longest-running and voted #1 Best Drag Brunch. Enjoy fierce performances, delicious food, and a lively atmosphere with Buff Faye's House Cast 2026. Tickets are for entry, food/drinks extra.

activities.title: Charlotte 49ers Baseball Game
activities.description: Catch the Charlotte 49ers take on the Tulane Green Wave in a college baseball matchup. Enjoy America's favorite pastime with tickets starting at just $16.
activities.location: Robert & Mariam Hayes Stadium, University City

activities.title: Leonard Ouzts Comedy Show
activities.description: Laugh out loud with comedian Leonard Ouzts at The Comedy Zone. Known for his sharp wit and relatable humor, it's a perfect evening for stand-up fans. Tickets are available for under $20 for some seating.

activities.title: RayBurger Live Concert
activities.description: Dance the night away with RayBurger at the Premier Event Center. This high-energy dance concert promises a vibrant atmosphere and great music. General admission tickets are typically affordable.

activities.title: Themed Craft Workshop: DIY Terrariums
activities.description: Unleash your creativity at a DIY Terrarium workshop. All materials are provided, and you'll leave with your own miniature ecosystem. A fun, hands-on activity.

activities.title: Find Your Muse Open MIC featuring Brook Pridemore
activities.description: Enjoy an evening of live music and spoken word at The Evening Muse's renowned open mic night, featuring a special performance by Brook Pridemore. Tickets are affordable and it's a great way to support local and touring artists.

activities.title: Themed Movie Night: Cult Classic Monday
activities.description: Grab a beer and settle in for a screening of a cult classic film. This weekly event offers a unique cinematic experience in a relaxed brewery setting.

activities.title: Board Game Night & Brews
activities.description: Join fellow gamers for a night of board games and craft brews. A small cover charge grants you access to a vast library of games and a welcoming community.

activities.title: Local Band Showcase
activities.description: Catch a showcase of Charlotte's best up-and-coming bands. This ticketed event supports local music and offers a diverse range of genres.

activities.title: Beginner's Pottery Wheel Class
activities.description: Try your hand at the pottery wheel in this introductory class. Learn basic techniques and create your own unique piece. All materials and firing included.

activities.title: Slay & Sashay Drag Brunch
activities.description: Kick off your Sunday with a fabulous drag brunch featuring high-energy performances by Charlotte's top queens. Expect dazzling costumes, comedic acts, and a lively atmosphere perfect for a fun afternoon.

activities.title: Leonard Ouzts Live Comedy
activities.description: Catch comedian Leonard Ouzts delivering his sharp wit and observational humor live on stage. This is a great chance to see a rising star in comedy in an intimate club setting.
activities.location: The Comedy Zone, AvidXchange Music Factory

activities.title: The Nude Party Concert
activities.description: Experience the raw energy of The Nude Party as they bring their garage rock and psychedelic sounds to the Neighborhood Theatre. Get ready for a high-octane performance that will have you dancing all night.

activities.title: Charlotte Knights Baseball: Golf Day
activities.description: Enjoy America's favorite pastime with the Charlotte Knights as they take on the Gwinnett Stripers, featuring special 'Golf Day' promotions. Expect pre-game putt-putt across the concourse and themed food specials.

activities.title: We're Having an Open Mic, Frank!
activities.description: Step up to the mic or enjoy local talent at this open mic night hosted by Maggie Lowe. Expect a diverse range of performances, from comedy to music, in a relaxed brewery setting.

activities.title: BOOM Charlotte Arts Festival (Final Day)
activities.description: Immerse yourself in the final day of BOOM Charlotte, a multi-day arts festival celebrating dance, music, theater, poetry, and visual art. Explore diverse performances and community-driven creativity across various venues.
activities.location: The Boardwalk at University City, University City

activities.title: Mindless Minutia Trivia
activities.description: Gather your smartest friends for a night of general knowledge trivia. Enjoy craft beers and friendly competition as you tackle a wide range of questions.

activities.title: Mindless Minutia Trivia Night
activities.description: Challenge your brain with Mindless Minutia Trivia, offering diverse categories to keep everyone engaged. It's a great way to unwind and enjoy some local brews on a Monday night.

activities.title: The Jam: CLT Mixtape
activities.description: Experience a unique fusion jam session, 'The Jam: CLT Mixtape,' featuring local musicians collaborating and improvising. Discover new sounds and enjoy a vibrant musical evening.
activities.location: Triple C Brewing Company, South End

activities.title: Dance With Me at Triple C
activities.description: Get your groove on at 'Dance With Me,' a social dance event held in the lively Barrel Room. Whether you're a seasoned dancer or just want to move, it's a fun way to spend your Monday evening.
activities.location: The Barrel Room at Triple C, South End

activities.title: BOOM Charlotte Fringe Festival
activities.description: Explore the experimental and avant-garde at the BOOM Charlotte Fringe Festival, featuring unique and boundary-pushing performances. Expect a diverse array of theater, dance, and art that challenges conventions.
activities.location: Shoppes at University Place, University City

activities.title: Star Wars Day: Meet Darth Vader & Screenings
activities.description: Celebrate Star Wars Day with themed screenings, special discounts, and a chance to meet Darth Vader himself. A must-attend for any fan looking to immerse themselves in the saga.
activities.location: Mac's Heroes & Villains Comics & Collectibles, Plaza Midwood

activities.title: The Kid LAROI: A Perfect World Tour
activities.description: Catch Australian singer and rapper The Kid LAROI on his 'A Perfect World Tour.' Known for his chart-topping hits and energetic stage presence, this concert promises a memorable night of pop and hip-hop.
activities.location: The Fillmore Charlotte, AvidXchange Music Factory

activities.title: Kinky Boots The Musical
activities.description: Don't miss the final performance of the Tony Award-winning musical 'Kinky Boots,' a heartwarming story of acceptance, friendship, and fabulous footwear. Enjoy high-energy numbers and a powerful message at this Broadway sensation.

activities.title: RayBurger Concert
activities.description: Experience an electrifying performance by RayBurger at the Premier Event Center. This dance-focused concert promises a high-energy atmosphere and a night of unforgettable music.

activities.title: Diva Royale Drag Queen Show
activities.description: Witness the spectacle of the Diva Royale Drag Queen Show, featuring celebrity impersonations and dazzling performances. Opt for a 'hot seat' for extra special attention from the queens, making for an unforgettable and interactive experience.

activities.title: ACC Men's Lacrosse Championship - Final
activities.description: Cheer on the top college lacrosse teams as they battle for the ACC Championship title. Witness high-stakes athletic competition in this thrilling final match.

activities.title: Secret Movie Series
activities.description: Dare to discover a mystery film at the 'Secret Movie Series,' where the title is kept under wraps until showtime. It's a unique cinematic experience for adventurous moviegoers who love a surprise.

activities.title: Diva Royale Drag Queen Show: Hot Seat Experience
activities.description: Beyond the dazzling performances, opt for the 'hot seat' at Diva Royale for an absurdly fun and personalized interaction with the drag queens. Be prepared for playful roasts, special attention, and unforgettable photo ops that are delightfully over-the-top.
